blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Fair weather with chances of thunderstorms are expected to persist in Metro Manila and other parts of the country on All Saints’ Day, Nov. 1, according to the weather bureau. In its morning weather forecast, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said the northeast monsoon, or amihan, and the shear line were the weather systems affecting parts of the country. READ: Cooler days seen as Pagasa declares onset of ‘amihan’ season Pagasa weather specialist Veronica Torres-Bagalanon said the shear line—or the boundary between northeasterly and easterly winds—was expected to bring cloudy skies with scattered rains […]...
